title: Positive and negative 3-energies of graphs
summary: For a simple graph $G$ with $n$ vertices, let $A_G$ denote the adjacency matrix of $G$, and let $λ_1(G) \geq λ_2(G) \geq \dots \geq λ_n(G)$ be its eigenvalues. For an integer $p \geq 2$, the positive $p$-energy and negative $p$-energy of $G$, denoted $\mathcal{E}^+_p(G)$ and $\mathcal{E}^-_p(G)$, are defined as follows: $\mathcal{E}^+_p(G) = \sum_{λ_i(G) > 0} |λ_i(G)|^p$ and $\mathcal{E}^-_p(G) = \sum_{λ_i(G) < 0} |λ_i(G)|^p,$ respectively.
